cases.scenario: A launch decision intentionally tracks total completed onboardings. Opportunity volume is fixed and a diagnostic rate is reported separately.
facts: The decision concerns absolute business volume

cases.scenario: A team compares total completed onboardings between periods, but eligible exposure volume may differ and is not supplied.
A proposed completion rate uses a denominator that the release itself can change, and zero-denominator handling is unspecified.
The promised outcome can occur days after exposure, but no observation window or maturity rule is supplied.
The proposed metric measures an intermediate click while the intended user outcome is successful task completion.
facts: No validated proxy relationship is supplied

cases.scenario: An application event exists, but the downstream metric definition is external and was not supplied.
A fixed AI evaluation passes, and a product-impact claim cites only that AI evaluation.
A source event candidate exists, but no validated runtime emission evidence is available.
Eligible population context is missing and multiple reasonable population definitions remain possible.
facts: No exception can be ruled out

cases.scenario: A generic best-practice statement recommends replacing every count with a ratio without a project-specific trigger.
